semantic.justification: AQF9AG adds the native tools::Time scalar needed by DateTime and calendar conversion. The signed64 decimal-packed field uses bigint; native component widths, constructor carry normalization and hour clamp, sign-preserving setters without carry, nanosecond/millisecond conversion and day fraction match the source paths. The CSS DateTime time-field constructor ignores IsUTC as upstream. System/UTC-offset/tick services, GetClock, UNO Time output and the remaining Time arithmetic operators are not represented; no JavaScript Date/calendar substitution is introduced. Tests cover ordinary defined scalar inputs, including packed values beyond binary64 exact-integer range and signed32 millisecond narrowing; C++ undefined overflow behavior is not certified. Source release-build hour clamping is retained; debug-only assertion diagnostics and undefined signed-overflow cases are not a certified runtime contract.
